season.title: Season and authority review
context: Requested season and event
Manual edition and update trail
Decision date and deadline timezone
steps: Open official manual and updates; identify the rule or explicitly unresolved question
Separate final rules, previews, announcements and planning pages
Record conflicting deadline wording and transaction-specific evidence
acceptance: Every legality claim has an official edition/rule citation
Unknown future timings or dimensions stay unknown
Team registration/payment status is not assumed
season.deliverable: A dated decision table with claim, authority, applicability and unresolved items

swerve.title: Swerve hardware and programming review
context: Exact module revision and motor-to-wheel ratio
Robot frame, module order and encoder zero
WPILib, vendor library and firmware versions
steps: Use skills/frc-swerve/SKILL.md to connect the maneuver and package to the two axes.
Inspect examples/swerve/README.md and the original Fusion archive for steering and wheel motion.
Replay straight, strafe, wrap and rotation cases before interpreting localization drift.
acceptance: Module locations and measured distances share one frame and order
Ratios and offsets have one documented owner
Geometry, replay and measured performance retain separate evidence
swerve.deliverable: A module and controls contract with CAD revision, offline checks and unresolved measurements

java.title: Java implementation and test plan
context: WPILib/GradleRIO/JDK versions
Subsystem ownership and command requirements
Desktop test versus robot deployment scope
steps: Trace inputs, units, subsystem state, command ownership and cleanup
Run desktop checks in the project using its pinned toolchain
Exercise timeout, interruption, disable and invalid-input paths before tuning
acceptance: Compile/test commands and actual results are recorded
Requested output and measured output are distinguished
Historical projects are not treated as reproduced by another release
java.deliverable: A code/test change plan with source versions and failure-path assertions

mechanism-cad.title: Mechanism and CAD evidence plan
context: Game-piece geometry and season envelope
Load cases, motion range and manufacturing process
CAD document/version and measurement provenance
steps: For an existing design, open docs/strategy-first-continuation.md from the plugin root. Locate the selected strategy decision and the latest test result before choosing the next experiment.
For a fresh kickoff design, trace the selected match story and its field-lab observations into a measurable capability before choosing a mechanism.
Sketch acquisition, transfer, staging and release states
Trace source-code caller/end/default/periodic paths independently of geometry
Define CAD joints, clearances, drawing dimensions and an export/reopen check
acceptance: Unmeasured dimensions and loads are marked assumptions
A command goal does not certify mechanical stopping or guarding
Source file and asset licenses are checked before reuse
mechanism-cad.deliverable: A state table, CAD review checklist and proposed measurement sheet

vision.title: Vision and localization contract
context: Camera/firmware/library/field-layout versions
Transform direction, units and field/alliance convention
Capture clock, latency, frame ordering and reset epoch
steps: Document frame transforms and timestamp origin before fusion
Exercise stale/future/outlier/duplicate/pre-reset behavior
Record calibration evidence separately from synthetic estimator tests
acceptance: Capture time is not silently replaced by arrival time
Fixture thresholds are not recommendations for every camera
No vision accuracy claim follows solely from source review
vision.deliverable: A frame/time contract and rejection-policy test table

modes.title: Teleop and autonomous acceptance plan
context: Selected season/manual and operating modes
Operator binding and interruption priority
Start pose, frame, completion and failure conditions
steps: Trace initial binding state, rising/falling edges, early finish and a new press
Separate readiness entry gates from continued feed authorization
Specify timeout, mode-transition cancellation and immediate versus next-periodic cleanup
acceptance: Every routine has bounded completion or explicit interruption behavior
Driver Station disable is distinguished from scheduler.disable
Trajectory reference limits are separate from corrected actuator commands
modes.deliverable: A mode/trigger transition matrix with expected software observations

troubleshoot.title: Device and evidence troubleshooting plan
context: Exact device/connector/firmware/client versions
Symptom timeline and targeted logs
Electrical, pneumatic, spring and gravity energy states
Conductor preparation and terminal revision; telemetry producer and validity
steps: Match the device-specific manual and changelog before interpreting indicators
Separate command, requested output, sensor reading and physical state
Preserve fault history; formulate one software/log hypothesis before a qualified physical procedure
Use the electrical evidence review to separate terminal acceptance, circuit protection, model-specific brownout behavior and missing current telemetry
Use the shared electrical supply review to compare the voltage at the required device during overlapping loads, then check the observed action outcome separately
acceptance: A warning indicator is not assumed to inhibit output
Component ratings do not establish season legality or every terminal specification
Battery variants/revisions and conflicting charge data stay explicit
No current sample or a displayed zero is treated as proof of a de-energized circuit
Bare-wire acceptance is not reused for ferrules; undocumented terminal values remain unknown
troubleshoot.deliverable: An expected/observed evidence table with source and next verification step

case-study.title: Rulebook-to-robot case study
context: One selected game season and exact official source snapshot
Team goals, tools, budget and available fabrication time
Scope of implemented robot slice and unexecuted CAD/hardware work
steps: Read selected official requirements and build a trace register before strategy choices
For a fresh kickoff, open docs/kickoff-field-lab.md. Have students move and resize a plain robot, capture observations and use them to draft their match story before showing historical strategies.
Compare at least three original strategy options using explicit assumptions and reliability/cost tradeoffs
Allocate subsystem interfaces and implement a tested Java vertical slice
Generate CAD inputs and record native Fusion execution/export/reopen separately
Run simulator nominal and fault scenarios; distinguish modeled behavior from physical validation
acceptance: Every requirement links to a source section and design/test evidence or an explicit gap
Historical game rules never imply historical software compatibility
Native CAD and simulator claims name executed artifacts and actual results
No hardware operation, automatic deployment or publication
case-study.deliverable: A season-specific evidence package with strategy comparison, subsystem contracts, runnable code, CAD inputs, simulator results and unresolved gates
